programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Road Trip Rescue
programme.desc: Carrying three baby kangaroos and an emu, the Irwins caravan into the Australian Outback to release the animals on Mourachan, their giant wildlife conservation property plans shift when they discover more animals in need of rescue along the way.

programme.title: I Was Prey: Night Stalker
programme.desc: A black bear charges Joe Azzouggagh and his German shepherd, Ace, deep in the Ontario wilderness single father Andrew Dickehage, forced to walk six miles along a rural road at night, comes under attack from unseen predators.

programme.title: Carter's W.A.R.: Sold Into Slavery
programme.desc: Ivan is investigating the illegal trade of bush meat in Kinshasa when he stumbles upon three captive baby chimpanzees that are being sold on the black market.

programme.title: Great White Shark Babies
programme.desc: Dr. Mauricio Hoyos teams up with Michelle Jewell and Toby Daly-Engel in search of where the pregnant females of Guadalupe have their pups. Mauricio believes they go to the coast of Baja, but what they find while they're there is a Shark Week first.

programme.title: Treetop Cat Rescue: Out on a Limb
programme.desc: Tom must navigate a sloping tree to rescue a difficult cat Shaun faces wet and damp conditions to save a friendly, homesick stray.

programme.title: The Zoo: The Elephant Next Door
programme.desc: The zoo staff works to build a relationship between a pair of Asian elephants with very different personalities vets treat an ocellated turkey chick's foot condition Isabella the North American beaver undergoes a tooth trim.

programme.title: Dogs: The Untold Story: Wild Survivors
programme.desc: Traveling the globe to explore the characteristics that make a wild dog wild, discover how their past has shaped your pet and learn the differences between your dog at home and its wild relatives.

programme.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Robert & the Rattlesnakes
programme.desc: Robert wrangles western diamondback rattlesnakes in Arizona for the first time, learning techniques passed down by his dad Terri helps save some of the hospital's tiniest patients, three baby feathertail gliders Bindi chats with Occa the cockatoo.
